text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Fest, an event where
Umamusume fans
gather at Tracen
Academy, is just around the
corner.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan's dream is to put a smile on
everyone's
face? That's so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're her trainer, so could we talk to
you about something? We might know
of an opportunity to
make her dream
come true...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having heard their proposal, I give them
the
go-ahead without hesitation. And
so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa? You want me to perform on the
main
stage during the Fan Fest?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The title of the show is "Kitasan
Black, Sing
Your Heart Out"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a two-part special performance,
and we
want you to take center stage!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aw, thanks! It's an honor to be the lead!
I... I'll do
my best!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you as the troupe ...
The troupe leader role is in your ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being able to entertain fans outside of
the racecourse is an important task. I
want her to do
the best she can and
make her dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the event...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaall right! You guys ready?! We're
starting
things off right with a race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This dream race is one you won't usually
get to
see anywhere else, so make sure
you don't miss a
second of it!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the eight contestants enter the
gates...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan?! I can't believe you're
challenging me
right out the gate... And
what speed...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, well... You barely even counted as
a small
fry last year, but look at you go
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As time passed, Kitasan Black's running
has improved, and now, she's able to
compete on
equal footing with the
upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next up, we have a concert! Getting to
sing so
many songs in front of everyone
feels like a
dream!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: YEEEAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here I go! Let's kick it off with a
little
opening!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!
Whoa, whoa,
whoa, whoa!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's time for us to meet at laaaast! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Kita's really pulling out all the
stops,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black belts out song after song
in her
signature enka singing style.
choice_data_list: Well, that's part of its charm.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Goal after goal, forever winniiiiing the
soooul! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The extinctive need for speeed! Burning
hotter
with every rival I beeeat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-her singing style is so unique! I don't
think I'll
ever listen to the song the same
way again.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Did she just get that line slightly wrong,
though? For a second, I got this freaky
image of an
asteroid hurtling toward the
Earth...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The whole concert ends up clocking out
at two and a half hours. Kitasan Black
and the others
manage to successfully
complete the show.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(We've made so many people happy.
They're all
smiling so much...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(This is it. This is the very thing I've
always wanted
to do!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Running, singing, coming together as
one, and
getting everyone fired up!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I want to do this forever and ever. Except... I wanna do it for real, not just at this festival!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, everyone! Thank
youuu!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the show is over, Kitasan Black
leaves the
stage.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming today!
May I shake
your hand as thanks?
Really, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll come watch us race in
person! We'll be just as incredible on the
track as we were here
during today's
event!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she's saying goodbye to
each person individually... She's treating
this Fan Fest
more seriously than anyone
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing, isn't she? No, she's more
than
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It might simply be in her blood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Distinguished families such as mine don't
remain distinguished for no reason. We
feel a calling to honor our
forebearers—you could say it runs in our
blood. Similarly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan has her own family and her own
blood flowing through her veins. Hers
drives her do
everything she can to make
people happy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Thank you, thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Kitasan Black sincerely thank
every single fan without rest, I begin to
realize the truth
behind Mejiro
McQueen's observation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to make everyone happy is
what
connects her to the next race and
the one after
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the show is over, Kitasan Black
goes outside
the venue to see the fans
off.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Why are there still so many
people
around?! Don't tell me nobody's
left yet!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Kitasan Black! We had
a lot of
fun!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you to come out!
All right, everyone! Now that the main
star is here, let's
give her a final round of
applause!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's going on here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Slowly but surely, Kitasan Black has
taken root in
the people's hearts, and
because of that...
choice_data_list: They all seem like passionate fans.
They all seem like passionate fans...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An ocean of people now floods the area
outside the venue. Her innate
personality and charisma
have endeared
her to the masses.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on the success of
today's
performance! Come on,
everyone! Let's give her a
hand!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
To Kitasan Black's future success!
Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of lively clapping
reverberates through
the air. But that's
not all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeew... Boom, boom, boom!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks?! Did you do all this just for
me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Kitasan is so well-liked...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, hardly anyone paid
attention to Kitasan Black, but now, she
has so many people
rooting for her
success.

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
You've got this, Kitasan! Show us a
dream come
true this spring!

text_block_list.name: Fan F
text_block_list.text: Kitasan, you've gotta win, all right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will! Thank you, everyone! I won't let
you down!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I still have a long way to go, and I'm
nowhere near good enough yet, but I
hope you'll all stay with
me until the
very end and beyond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rapturous applause and cheering
show no signs of letting up. The event is
a grand success, and Umamusume and
fans alike are able to thank
each other.
